'''Dantooine Cane Syrup''' was a type of [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Sometime during the first three [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after the planet [[Makeb]]'s discovery during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found that [[pterathki]], [[Bird/Legends|avian]] creatures native to Makeb, were particularly delicious when basted in Dantooine cane syrup.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dantooine cane syrup was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the pterathki in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion released for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
